Object.label: Object
Object.comment: An entity that participates in the process, such as an order, invoice, or product. Each object is of exactly one object type and may carry attributes whose values can change over time.

Event.label: Event
Event.comment: An atomic, timestamped occurrence of an activity in the process, such as creating an order or inserting a payment. Each event is of exactly one event type and may relate to any number of objects.

Attribute.label: Attribute
Attribute.comment: A named, typed value associated with an event or object.

Time.label: Time point
Time.comment: A point in time, used as an event timestamp or to date an object attribute value.

ObjectAttribute.label: Object attribute
ObjectAttribute.comment: An attribute defined for an object type. Its value is recorded with a timestamp and may change over the object's lifetime.

EventAttribute.label: Event attribute
EventAttribute.comment: An attribute defined for an event type, carrying a single value fixed at the time of the event.

AttributeChange.label: Object attribute change
AttributeChange.comment: A timestamped record of an object attribute taking a new value, capturing the history of dynamic object attribute values.

observed_at.label: observed at
observed_at.comment: Relates an event to the time point of its timestamp.

observes.label: observes
observes.comment: Inverse of observed at: relates a time point to the events timestamped at it.

event_object_relation.label: involves object
event_object_relation.comment: A qualified event-to-object relationship, associating an event with an object that takes part in it.

object_object_relation.label: is related to object
object_object_relation.comment: A qualified object-to-object relationship, associating an object with another object independently of any event.

has_attribute.label: has attribute
has_attribute.comment: Relates an event or object to one of its attributes.

attribute_of.label: is attribute of
attribute_of.comment: Inverse of has attribute: relates an attribute to its owning event or object.

has_data_value.label: has data value
has_data_value.comment: Attaches a literal value to an attribute, attribute change, or time individual.

inv_event_object_relation.label: is object involved in
inv_event_object_relation.comment: Inverse of involves object: relates an object to the events it participates in.

inv_object_object_relation.label: is related from object
inv_object_object_relation.comment: Inverse of is related to object: the symmetric counterpart of an object-to-object relationship.

has_attribute_change.label: has attribute change
has_attribute_change.comment: Relates an object to a record of one of its attribute changes.

inv_has_attribute_change.label: is attribute change of
inv_has_attribute_change.comment: Inverse of has attribute change: relates an attribute change record to the object whose attribute it tracks.

attribute_change_value.label: changes value to
attribute_change_value.comment: Relates an attribute change record to the value the attribute took at that change.

inv_attribute_change_value.label: is new value in change
inv_attribute_change_value.comment: Inverse of changes value to: relates an attribute value to the change record in which it became the new value.

changed_at.label: changed at
changed_at.comment: Relates an attribute change record to the time point at which the change took effect.

inv_changed_at.label: is change time of
inv_changed_at.comment: Inverse of changed at: relates a time point to the attribute change records that took effect at it.
